params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: page
params.description: Current page of the collection.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set. Values above 100 return 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to posts published after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to posts published before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_after
params.description: Limit response to posts modified after a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: modified_before
params.description: Limit response to posts modified before a given ISO 8601 compliant date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: status
params.description: Limit result set to items assigned one or more statuses. Anonymously only `publish` is permitted; any other value returns 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Sort collection by object attribute.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit result set to items with particular parent IDs.

params.name: parent_exclude
params.description: Limit result set to all items except those of a particular parent ID.

params.name: menu_order
params.description: Limit result set to posts with a specific menu_order value.

items.docs: Lists published pages. On this deployment the collection is the whole public site — 6 pages: Home (id 15), Team (16), Pipeline (17), Contact (18), Terms of Use (174) and Privacy Policy (178). The Team page renders 14 staff biographies from a non-REST custom post type, so the individual biographies are not retrievable through this API; only the rendered page HTML in `content.rendered` contains them.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier for the object.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: password
params.description: The password for the page if it is password protected.

items.docs: Retrieves one corporate page by numeric ID. `content.rendered` carries the full page HTML — for id 17 (Pipeline) and id 16 (Team) this is the only machine-reachable form of the pipeline and leadership content.
